Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL4028801. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4028801'. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID.
